QUOTE: "Deny is the only check that can't be bypassed." and "ServerManager::execute ... is_denied(tool, pattern)? ──yes──► "Error: Permission denied for <tool>" route_tool_call → server"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says deny is the hard gate in execute, but also describes an approval gate that can reject calls ("Permission denied" at approval, anti-spiral, schema, etc.), so it doesn't conclude that deny is the only blocker and that execute consults nothing else.
